thread:
Priya: FYI customer BrightWave just opened a P1 citing missing audit entries for their tenant between 2025-04-12T02:00Z and 2025-04-12T03:30Z. They say exports for that window return empty results. Can oncall/infra confirm scope?

Sam: I'm on it. Can you paste the export command they used?

Priya: They sent this: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit?start=2025-04-12T02:00:00Z&end=2025-04-12T03:30:00Z&customer=brightwave\"` -> responded with `[]`. They have other customers unaffected.

Jonas: Checking retention and S3 shards now. Initial quick check: audit-service reported successful writes for that tenant in app logs, but the audit index shard for region-eu-2 shows a gap. Pasting tail of app log: ```2025-04-12T02:10:12Z INFO audit: wrote event id=ae2f3 tenant=brightwave idx=45923``` then later ```2025-04-12T03:05:32Z ERROR indexer: failed put shard=idx-eu-2-obs msg=Unauthorized: KMS access denied```

Marta: Unauthorized KMS access for indexer? That would explain missing entries if writes couldn't be indexed. Do we have KMS/HSM rotation actions around that time?

Jonas: There was an automated KMS key rotation job scheduled at 2025-04-12T01:58Z for EU keys (rotation-controller). It completed but the indexer didn't pick up new key ARN due to a permissions propagation lag. I see `kms:Decrypt` calls from indexer failing between 02:00-03:10Z.

Priya: Customer impact scope? Just BrightWave or others?

Jonas: From a quick scan, only tenants routed to the affected index shard (idx-eu-2) and writing during the KMS propagation window are impacted. That's ~7 tenants; BrightWave is the only one that opened a ticket so far.

Sam: Can we surface a short mitigation plan: immediate read/restore for customer and prevention?

Marta: Mitigation steps I'm proposing: 1) Give Read-only export from S3 backup for the missing window (we have raw audit events in cold S3 bucket). 2) Backfill the index from S3 into audit-indexer with a forced key mapping after we confirm key access. 3) Add an alert for KMS propagate failures and block rotation controller if any critical writers report KMS errors.

Jonas: Technical notes for backfill: run `python backfill.py --tenant brightwave --start 2025-04-12T02:00:00Z --end 2025-04-12T03:30:00Z --force-key-arn arn:aws:kms:eu:xxx:key/REPLACEME` on a maintenance node. Expected time ~30-60m for this window. I'll queue job once infra-bot gives the green.

infra-bot: Backfill job queued: job-id=bf-20250412-001 assigned=jonas status=queued ETA=~45m

Evelyn: Legal/comms: we need proposed customer messaging. Recommend initial empathy + immediate workaround (S3 export) + ETA for full restore and a promise of RCA within 72h. Do not say 'data loss' until we confirm backfill, say 'temporary gap in indexed audit results'.

Priya: Draft message for BrightWave to review before sending: "We discovered a temporary gap in indexed audit results for your tenant between 2025-04-12T02:00Z and 2025-04-12T03:30Z due to internal key propagation failures during scheduled rotation. We can provide a complete export of raw audit events for that window immediately and are running an index backfill (ETA ~48 hours). We are treating this as a P1 and will follow up with a full RCA within 72 hours. Apologies for the disruption." Thoughts?

Marta: Good. Add a sentence that we are not aware of any access or exfiltration associated with this event.

Evelyn: Ok with that addition. Also add contact path for security questions and request whether they want us to notify their security/contact list.

Sam: Operational timeline (proposed): - 0-1h: Confirm scope, provide S3 export (done once infra confirms bucket access). - 1-6h: Run backfill job and validate indexing. - 6-72h: Monitor for regressions, prepare RCA draft. If backfill fails, escalate to SRE and consider manual restore.

Jonas: Backfill started now on maintenance node bf-20250412-001. I will post progress.

infra-bot: job bf-20250412-001 started at 2025-04-12T04:12:00Z assigned=jonas

Priya: I will send the initial customer note (with Evelyn's edits) and include the S3 export link as soon as infra confirms it's available.

Jonas: First backfill progress: 30% complete, reindexing 12k events. No further KMS errors observed after I re-applied key policy.

Priya: Sent initial message to BrightWave (support ticket #BW-9982). Copied Security and Legal.

Evelyn: Please attach the internal timeline and the S3 checksum so they can verify integrity.

Jonas: Backfill complete at 2025-04-12T04:45:23Z. Validated event counts match backup. Index now returns expected records for their query.

Priya: Customer confirmed they can see the exported entries and index results. Marking incident as customer-resolved but keeping P1 open until RCA.

Marta: Assigning RCA owners: Jonas (technical cause), Sam (mitigations/alerts), Evelyn (comms/legal). Please aim for draft within 72 hours.

Sam: A few followups: - Add rotation-controller pre-check to validate KMS policy propagation - Add automated smoke test that runs a sample write+read to each index shard post-rotation. I'll make a GH issue.

Jonas: GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/842 - backfill and KMS rotation mitigations tracked.

Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll close the customer loop after RCA is published. :white_check_mark:

Marta: Noting for audits: we need to record this in compliance log with start/end times and remediation steps. I'll create the compliance entry.

infra-bot: Incident P1 updated: status=customer-resolved postmortem_required=true owners=[Jonas,Sam,Evelyn]
